title: download from video sites with the optional extractor (manual until automated)

clauses.text: Store, Setup lists the video-site downloader with its licence text, its size and an Install button.

steps.do: Open Store, Setup and find the video-site downloader in the Media group.
steps.expect: Its licence text and its size (about 3 MB) are shown, with an Install button.

clauses.text: The program is fetched from the vendor only when the person presses Install, and its file is checked before it is used.

steps.do: Press Install and wait until the card says it is installed.
steps.expect: The card says installed when the download and check finish. If the check fails, the card says so and nothing is marked installed.

clauses.text: A download needs approval, and only public https addresses are used.

steps.do: Ask the assistant to download a video from a public https video address.
steps.expect: An approval card appears before anything runs. A private or local address is refused in words.

clauses.text: A finished download goes to the Videos folder and into MEDIA, and the card says what it is.

steps.do: Approve the download, wait for it to finish, then open MEDIA.
steps.expect: The video is in the Videos folder and listed in MEDIA, and the card says what was downloaded.

clauses.text: Remove deletes the downloader program and keeps the videos.

steps.do: In Store, Setup, choose Remove for the video-site downloader.
steps.expect: The program is removed and the videos already downloaded stay in Videos.
